text:
sasha: Heads-up: planning to flip feature flag phrase_cache_v2 to a phased canary (5%) tonight at Tue 18:30 PST. No DB schema changes. Goal: validate latency and token deltas. Who's owning the deploy and smoke?

anna: I can own the deploy. Will merge the PR at 18:05, start canary with deploy script at 18:30. @mike please monitor perf dashboards. @lucy can you pre-populate safe defaults?

mike: On perf. I'll watch these dashboards: /dashboards/infra/ingress-latency, /dashboards/model/phrase-cache. Focus p95/p99 latency, request error rate, and token-generation delta. Alert thresholds: p99 +50ms or errors >0.5% -> rollback.

lucy: Safe defaults: flag default = false, rollout percentage controlled from config service. I added the config change to the PR:

```
feature_flags:
  phrase_cache_v2:
    default: false
    rollout_percent: 0
    kill_switch: true
```

anna: Good. Deploy steps I'll run (copying for record):

```
git checkout main
git merge --no-ff feature/phrase-cache-v2
ci/build && ci/test --smoke
/ops/deploy canary --service=runtime --flag=phrase_cache_v2 --percent=5
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy for runtime at 2026-03-17T18:30:00-08:00 (UTC-8).

mike: I'll set a 30min watch window starting at 18:30 and post metrics every 5m. If latency breach or error spike, call rollback.

sasha: Rollback play: @anna will run:

```
/ops/flag_toggle.sh --env=prod --flag=phrase_cache_v2 --action=disable
/ops/route_traffic --service=runtime --to=stable
```

anna: Confirmed. I have shortcuts for both. Pager oncall: kevin. @kevin are you available to assist if we need manual routing?

kevin: Available tonight. I'll standby.

lucy: Also added automated smoke tests run on canary target:

```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \
  https://runtime.prod.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke check"}' | jq '.ok'
```

mike: If we see token budget > expected by >10% we pause and investigate cost model.

anna: PR merged 18:09, CI green. I'll push at ~18:30. Link: https://git.redwood/internal/pr/2345

sasha: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: runtime / 5% -> nodes [gpu-12,gpu-14]

mike: 18:35 metrics: p95 +10ms, p99 +30ms, errors 0.03%. token delta +3%. LGTM to ramp to 25% after 30m if stable.

anna: Ramping to 25% now (manual): /ops/deploy ramp --flag=phrase_cache_v2 --percent=25

deploy-bot: Ramped to 25%.

mike: Monitoring continues. Next checkpoint 19:05.

sasha: Nice. Keep logs of any anomalies in the incident channel and tag me. If no issues, we'll target 100% in tomorrow morning maintenance window.

lucy: :thumbsup: Will update the feature flag dashboard and mark default off.
